leadRow.title: Model safeguards can be challenged through coordinated extraction

evidence.significance: OpenAI describes layered defences against adversarial distillation, including request-level protection and investigations. These are the provider’s account of its controls, not independent evidence of their effectiveness.

leadRow.title: APRA links AI risk with shared provider dependencies

evidence.sourceTitle: APRA's System Risk Outlook - November 2026 | APRA
evidence.significance: APRA says AI can create risks within firms and accelerate external threats, while shared material providers can transmit disruption. Some individual providers support institutions holding more than half of APRA-regulated financial assets; this is Australian supervisory evidence, not a measurement of any individual firm’s exposure.

leadRow.title: CCP outsourcing permissions remain subject to final legislation
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-11-16

evidence.sourceTitle: Near-final Statement of Policy: The Bank of England’s approach to permissions in relation to CCP rules (disclosure, outsourcing and interoperability arrangements permissions)
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: The Bank of England published a near-final policy on permissions for central counterparties, including outsourcing major risk-management activities. It remains subject to final Treasury legislation.

leadRow.title: FSB calls for stronger stablecoin oversight in Türkiye

evidence.sourceTitle: FSB recommends Türkiye further strengthens its regulatory framework for crypto-assets and stablecoins
evidence.significance: The FSB recommends a dedicated stablecoin regime, stronger supervision and enforcement, and cross-border cooperation in Türkiye. These are recommendations to authorities, not new obligations already imposed on firms.

leadRow.title: CFTC alleges a large investment scheme misrepresented trading
leadRow.source: Primary / US Commodity Futures Trading Commission / 2026-11-20

evidence.sourceTitle: CFTC Charges 11 Companies and Two Indiana Executives in $550 Million Fraud Scheme
evidence.significance: The CFTC alleges that a group solicited over $550 million while claiming returns from leveraged foreign-exchange trading. The complaint is an allegation, not a finding of liability.

leadRow.title: Outage recovery messages can become a phishing lure

evidence.sourceTitle: High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors
evidence.significance: Microsoft reports a high-volume campaign impersonating Microsoft 365 service-health messages. It assesses the activity was likely credential phishing; its evidence did not confirm credential capture or later compromise.

leadRow.title: Google Cloud’s London region outage exposes cross-zone recovery limits

evidence.sourceTitle: Google Cloud Service Health incident: europe-west2
evidence.significance: Google’s incident report describes a power event in europe-west2-b followed by capacity constraints and impact across the London region. Firms should check whether cross-zone failover and critical-service recovery work under regional control-plane and capacity stress.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Google Cloud Status incident page states the event date as 20 October and describes the europe-west2-b power event and subsequent regional impacts. Primary page rechecked on 22 November 2026.

leadRow.title: Plaintext passwords exposed a basic control failure
leadRow.source: Primary / Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés / 2026-11-18

evidence.sourceTitle: Conservation des mots de passe clients en clair : la CNIL prononce une sanction de 5 millions d’euros
evidence.organisation: Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
evidence.significance: France’s CNIL fined an unnamed company €5 million after finding, among other issues, that customer passwords were stored in plaintext. The decision concerns that company, not the state of controls across financial services.

sourceDateVerification.reason: The CNIL primary page displays 18 novembre 2026 immediately below its headline and describes the sanction and plaintext passwords. The page date and decision were checked directly.
